R6C-bear-drive-0001.name: By MacIntyre Creek
R6C-bear-drive-0001.pressureWhy: No town, pavement or rec site within 1 km and not behind a closure (estimate).
R6C-bear-drive-0001.parkWhat: pull off on an unnamed gravel road

evidence.t: Cutblock harvested 2010 (16 years old), 30 m NE: cutblocks and logging road edges green up first in spring (65%) and grow berries for the fall feed (lesson: Black bear).
S facing slope, 14 degrees: grassy south facing slopes are spring bear food (90%, lesson: Black bear Masterclass 5).
MacIntyre Creek 110 m SE: stream sides and skunk cabbage swamps are spring food, and bears forage on berries and spawning fish in fall (90%, lesson: Black bear Masterclass 5).
1 km or more from pavement and 2 km from a town: bears near people feed more at night (75%, lesson: Black bear Masterclass 6).

seasonRows.notes: MU 6-12 is not listed in the Region 6 black bear rows (my reading of the table).

plan: Drive: from Village of Daajing Giids, about 24 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 53.17227, -131.83915, pull off on an unnamed gravel road. Map links below.
Walk: 200 m E, cross country, no trail mapped. Climb about 0 m, about 5 min at 3 km/h.

Hunt: black bear, season: VERIFY. Glass berry slopes, cutblocks and road edges at dawn and the last 2 hours of light, wind in your face (Tip). A bear under 2 years old and any bear with it are closed (99%, synopsis page 11).
Use: your .308 Winchester with a 150 to 180 grain expanding bullet (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 6-12, Region 6. Season: no general open season (synopsis page 50, 95%). 1 legal flag below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-10-05, closures 2026-10-16.
R6C-bear-drive-0001.popWhy: Less popular (quieter): MU 6-12: about 67 hunter days a year for black bear (2020 to 2024 mean), 0.00 days per square km, bottom third of BC MUs; access: average access. Estimate, about 50% sure (my pick).

tags.label: Good for 2
tags.why: Cover edge here (cutblock or burn): one hunter sits at a crossing or glasses, the other walks the edge slowly with the wind at their back toward the stander. Agree zones of fire, a meeting point and a time at the truck (Tip, lesson: Hunting with a partner). Pushes are on foot only (99%, synopsis page 11, item 25).

tags.label: Good solo
tags.why: Short pack out: 0.2 km and about 0 m of climb from the parking (Tip). Cell coverage is not in the data: leave a trip plan and carry SOS or a satellite messenger (lesson: Bush safety).

R6C-grouse-drive-0001.name: By Copper Creek
R6C-grouse-drive-0001.pressureWhy: No town, pavement or rec site within 1 km and not behind a closure (estimate).
R6C-grouse-drive-0001.parkWhat: pull off on Copper Bay Mainline (gravel road)

evidence.t: Road: Copper Bay Mainline, 5.5 km stretch.
100% of the stretch in grouse forest zones (BWBS, CWH, ESSF, ICH, IDF, MS, SBPS, SBS).
4 cutblocks touch the road (30 years old or less): edges and clover.
15 wetlands, lakes or creeks along the road: riparian edges.

flags.t: Route crosses reserve land: KASTE 6. Get permission from the band office to hunt on or across it (synopsis page 9, 99%).

seasonRows.notes: No row in the Region 6 table (pages 50 and 51), so no general open season (page 5: open seasons are only those in the synopsis).

plan: Drive: from Village of Daajing Giids, about 28 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 53.15889, -131.8028, pull off on Copper Bay Mainline (gravel road). Map links below.
Walk or drive slowly: the Copper Bay Mainline stretch, 5.5 km one way. About 110 min one way at 3 km/h.
Hunt: grouse, Sept, Oct, Nov (season rows). Walk slowly in the first and last 2 hours of light. Watch where cutblocks and creeks meet the road (Tip).
Use: .22 rimfire for a sitting grouse inside 25 m (27 yd), or a shotgun with lead 6 or 7.5 (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 6-12, Region 6. Season: grouse Sept 10 to Nov 15 and more rows (synopsis page 51, 99%). 2 legal flags below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-10-05, closures 2026-10-16.
